Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses CONSULTANCY SERVICES FOR NABL ISO/ IEC 17025:2017 BRIEF SCOPE OF JOB: ================ To engage a qualified consultancy firm to assist HPCL, HP Green R & D center, Engine lab in achie ving ISO/IEC 17025:2017 compliant National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Labor atories (NABL) accreditation for its Engine Test Laboratory, covering documentation, training, impl ementation, internal audits, and readiness for NABL external audit. The facility at HP Green R&D c enter, Engine laboratory is capable of testing fuels, lubricant & additives of engine and vehicles fol lowing BSVI emission norms. The specific focus of the work is to obtain the NABL accreditation to HP Green R&D center, Engine laboratory for the testing emission with current BHARAT STAGE (BS) VI emission norms and performance (Power, torque, fuel economy, etc.) of the engine/vehicle. The HP Green R&D Centre (HPGRDC) lab is equipped with a Horiba MEXA ONE Emission Measurement System, including C1 and D1 analyzers, and a Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR)-based system for measuring both regulated and unregulated emission components of engine and vehicle. For detailed scope of job refer Tender Specification Document, technical specification & PQC docu ment attached to this tender. (Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document) HPCL’S SCOPE =========== · Ensuring all provision of necessary resources to meet the NABL Accreditation process. · Ensuring system adheres to the standard and if any deviation is noted, timely reporting to the co nsultant will be done by HPCL for carrying out necessary corrective action. · Adhering and ensuring that all requirements of NABL are compliant. · Maintenance, calibration of equipment and instruments to be carried by HPCL.

· Engagement of the PT/ILC agency identified and selected by the consultant through a separate te nder, and all logistics for PT/ILC including packing, transportation and insurance of engines and ve hicles, mounting at the external facility, fuel and testing charges. For detailed scope of job refer Tender Specification Document, technical specification & PQC docu ment attached to this tender. (Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document) NDA CLAUSE ========== The selected consultant must sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) with an agreement with HP CL after issuance of Purchase Order (PO). No work shall commence before execution of this NDA. All documentation, SOPs, training material, and quality manuals prepared under this contract shall remain the exclusive property of HPCL. Note: NDA Format attached in (Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document) VALIDITY OF THE CONTRACT / ORDER ============================== Contract shall be valid till 31.03.2028. JOB TO COMPLETE | JOB TO COMMENCE =============================== The estimated duration for obtaining NABL accreditation for the facilities mentioned in this tender is presented below. The total completion period is 54 weeks from the date mentioned in Gem PO. However, the contract shall be valid up to 31.03.2028. Activity Description Estimated Duration from the date Mentioned in Ge m PO Site Validation 4 weeks Training & Documentation Development 4 weeks Internal Audit & Management review meeting 12 weeks NABL Application Submission 1 week External Audit Preparation 3 weeks

Post-Audit Corrective Actions 2 weeks PT/ILC identification, coordination and evaluatio 16 weeks n External NABL review members visit 12 weeks Site Address: - ----------------- HP GREEN R&D CENTRE KIADB Industrial Area | Tarabanahalli | Near Devanagonthi Railway Station Hoskote Taluk | Bengaluru – 560 067 | Karnataka | India PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE | LIQUIDATED DAMAGES ========================================= Not Applicable COMPREHENSIVE PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE / RETENTION ==================================================== Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. Quantum: 5 % shall be applicable on total contract value. Duration: valid till 31.03.2028 plus 2 months claim period. SECURITY DEPOSIT ================ Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. Quantum: 2 % Shall be applicable on total contract value. PAYMENT TERMS ============== · As per General Terms Condition Payment Terms, with billing on completion of each li ne item and no advance payment. · Each invoice shall be processed corresponding to a completed activity as per the defi ned scope and will be considered for processing only after the vendor submits all relev ant documents in accordance with the defined scope of work. · The vendor must clearly state the activity description, quantity (if applicable), and co rresponding cost of each work completed, upon which the final invoice shall be shared f or further processing based on documentary evidence. · Completion of each milestone shall be subject to verification by HPCL, whose decisio n in this regard shall be final. No advance payment shall be made. Payment shall be rel eased as per the milestone-wise payment percentage given below, only after the assoc iated milestone is fully completed and accepted by HPCL. Milestone Payment (% of Order Value)

Site Validation 5% Training & Documentation Development 15% Internal Audit & Management Review Meeting 10% NABL Application Submission 15% External Audit Preparation 5% Post-Audit Corrective Actions 10% PT/ILC identification, coordination and evaluation 10% Grant of NABL accreditation (after External NABL asse 30% ssment) Total 100% · The Rates shall be FIRM during the entire Validity of the Order. SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS =========================== All documentation, SOPs, training material, and quality manuals prepared under this contract shall remain the exclusive property of HPCL. GENERAL NOTES & IMPORTANT INFORMATION ===================================== Unless otherwise specified, in case of conflict, HPCL’s General Terms and Condition (HPCL GTC) sh all take precedence over GEM’s General Terms and Conditions (GeM GTC).
